mean_cn: n.荒漠，沙漠（读作/ˈdezərt/）；  v.离弃（读作/dɪˈzɜːt/）；擅离职守
mean_en: a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand.
sentence: I finally found water in the desert.
sentence_trans: 我终于在沙漠里找到水了。
word_etyma: de分开 + sert加入，插入 → 不再加入 → desert离开
